battle.name: 1805年埃及革命
battle.brief: 中文維基戰爭列表將1805年埃及革命列為獨立衝突；這場變動發生於穆罕默德・阿里在埃及重建地方軍政權力、削弱舊有奧托曼控制之際。輪發槍（Wheellock pistol）自1500年列裝，是歐洲早期火器體系中的單兵手槍型號。

kit.name: 輪發槍
kit.history: 最早的後膛手槍。機械太貴，只給火槍隊的軍官與衛兵。

countries: 這篇實錄把「1805年埃及革命」視為從三月延續至十一月中旬的政治軍事行動，而不是單一會戰。參與者包括由上埃及武裝起義者賽義德·阿里·辛朱特尼率領的隊伍、獲奧斯曼帝國任命為埃及總督的穆罕默德·阿里及其阿爾巴尼亞步兵、英國皇家海軍在席德尼·史密斯爵士率領的分隊，以及拿破崙法國派駐埃及的遠征軍、砲兵和海軍增援。地理軸線由上埃及沿尼羅河谷通往開羅與三角洲，再經西奈連接雅法及地中海，最後撤至亞歷山大港的則是法軍。埃及起義者、奧斯曼部隊與英軍只是階段性同盟，沒有永久性的共同指揮系統；法軍則依靠開羅、尼羅河航路和亞歷山大港維持三個相互支援的支點。
countriesEn: This record treats the Egyptian Revolution of 1805 as a political-military campaign extending from March to the middle of November, rather than as a single set-piece battle. The participants were armed insurgents in Upper Egypt under Sayyid Ali al-Sinjutni; an Albanian infantry force commanded by Muhammad Ali, whom the Ottoman Empire appointed governor of Egypt; a British Royal Navy squadron and landing parties under Commodore Sir Sidney Smith; and, on the opposing side, Napoleonic French expeditionary troops, artillery and a naval reinforcement. The geographical axis ran from Upper Egypt along the Nile valley to Cairo and the Delta, then through Sinai to Acre and the Mediterranean, while the remaining French troops withdrew toward Alexandria. The Egyptian insurgents, Ottoman troops and British forces formed a temporary coalition without a permanent joint command, whereas the French relied on Cairo, the Nile route and Alexandria as three mutually supporting bases.
people: 賽義德·阿里·辛朱特尼於三月在上埃及起兵，率領武裝隊伍沿尼羅河谷向開羅推進，使法軍及與法國合作的地方軍事單位退守城堡和要害據點；他邀請奧斯曼中央政府派員接管埃及，但沒有足夠兵力自行長期圍困開羅。六月，蘇丹馬哈茂德二世任命穆罕默德·阿里為埃及總督。穆罕默德·阿里於七月十三日率首批約二千名阿爾巴尼亞士兵抵達雅法，再沿北西奈的井泉與驛站路線向開羅行進。開羅法軍由雅克－弗朗索瓦·梅努指揮，八月下旬抵達亞歷山大的法國海軍指揮官夏爾－勒內·馬通則帶來艦隊增援。史密斯率英軍在近海封鎖、接應穆罕默德·阿里並攻擊法軍沿海陣地，卻沒有接管埃及的陸上政治權。梅努於九月二十日交出開羅後，軍事主導權迅速由辛朱特尼的起義政權轉入穆罕默德·阿里手中，開羅的馬穆克克貝伊則在各派之間周旋，未能形成獨立且持續的指揮中心。
peopleEn: Sayyid Ali al-Sinjutni rose in Upper Egypt in March and led an armed column along the Nile valley toward Cairo, forcing French troops and local military units cooperating with France to withdraw into the citadel and other strongpoints. He invited the Ottoman central government to assume responsibility for Egypt but lacked the strength to maintain a prolonged siege of Cairo by himself. In June, Sultan Mahmud II appointed Muhammad Ali governor of Egypt. Muhammad Ali reached Acre on 13 July with an initial contingent of about two thousand Albanian soldiers and then advanced toward Cairo along the northern Sinai routes supplied with wells and stopping stations. General Jacques-François Menou commanded the French in Cairo, while Charles-René Magon arrived at Alexandria with a naval reinforcement in late August. Smith’s British force supported Muhammad Ali offshore, blockaded the coast and attacked French shore positions, but it did not assume political control of Egypt. After Menou surrendered Cairo on 20 September, military authority shifted rapidly from Sinjutni’s insurgent movement to Muhammad Ali, while the Mamluk beys in Cairo manoeuvred among the competing factions without establishing an independent, durable command centre.
kits: 各方的裝備並不屬於同一套供應體系。法軍步兵核心使用Charleville 1795燧發滑膛槍，標準刺刀長約十四又二分之一英吋；野戰砲兵可見已列裝的格里博瓦爾四磅輕型野戰砲與八磅野戰砲，城堡和港口則使用不同口徑的固定砲台，亞歷山大外港的馬利奥特及蓋特貝一帶亦設有 masonry 海防砲位。法軍的弹藥以定量紙包裝載入腰箱，遠征初期主要依靠地中海航運與亞歷山大港補給，並非所有_units都能獲得同型新槍。穆罕默德·阿里帶來的阿爾巴尼亞步兵使用燧發長槍、單發手枪、彎刀與短型土耳其刀，軍服和火砲口徑並不完全一致；其後方仍由馬匹及馱獸攜帶飲水、飼料、彈藥和野戰口糧，跨越西奈時尤其依賴有限井泉。法軍以制式槍械和炮術維持城防，英軍登岸隊及海軍陸戰分隊則使用英軍1795式燧發槍，并攜帶海軍短劍與登船長矛。史密斯分隊中的HMS Canopus是1786年下水的八十門二級戰列艦，其1805年前後的主砲包括三十二磅、二十四磅、十二磅與九磅級長砲；實際編組會隨改裝調配，不能以單一固定數字概括整支遠征艦隊。
kitsEn: The opposing forces did not draw their equipment from a common supply system. The core French infantry used Charleville 1795 flintlock muskets with bayonets approximately fourteen and a half inches long. Their field artillery included Gribeauval four-pounder light field guns and eight-pounder field guns already in service, while the citadel and harbour positions employed fixed batteries of mixed calibre. The coastal defences around Alexandria and the approaches to Fort Qaitbay also contained masonry gun positions. French ammunition was carried in quantified paper cartridges held in waist boxes, and the expedition depended heavily on Mediterranean shipping and Alexandria for replenishment; individual units did not all receive newly manufactured standard weapons. Muhammad Ali’s Albanian infantry carried flintlock long guns, single-shot pistols, curved sabres and short Ottoman swords, with no completely uniform clothing or artillery calibre across the entire force. Horses and pack animals transported water, fodder, ammunition and field rations, making access to wells particularly important during the Sinai movement. French troops relied on standard muskets, artillery and fortification technique for their static defence, while British naval and marine detachments used the British 1795-pattern flintlock musket and carried naval swords or boarding pikes. HMS Canopus, part of Smith’s force, was an eighty-gun second-rate ship launched in 1786 whose armament around 1805 included long guns of 32-, 24-, 12- and 9-pound calibre. Its exact distribution changed with refits and cannot be represented as one immutable total for the expedition.
tactics: 三月的起義先採包圍與機動，而不是立即投入大型正面會戰。辛朱特尼的隊伍沿上埃及道路攻擊孤立哨所、控制渡口和stretched communications，使法軍必須把兵力分散在開羅、尼羅河航線與亞歷山大之間。穆罕默德·阿里其後沒有橫穿無水荒漠，而是讓主力由雅法沿北西奈較可靠的井泉路線推進，以分隊、運輸隊和補給點保持連續行軍；阿爾巴尼亞步兵負責控制道路與包圍陣地，英軍則把法軍注意力引向海上。開羅法軍避免在開闊地帶決戰，倚靠城牆、砲兵和通往亞歷山大港的道路進行短程出擊，並設法保存船運補給。聯軍沒有以大型攻城重砲強攻開羅，而是由陸上封鎖、英軍制海權和期限明確的談判共同迫使梅努接受撤退條款，這使法軍得以及時撤往亞歷山大港。開羅投降後，戰事重心轉向海岸：馬通的海軍分隊集中於阿布基爾與亞歷山大，英軍則控制外海，利用艦砲、海軍陸戰隊和登岸分隊攻擊港口及蓋特貝堡一帶。因此，整場行動的特徵是上埃及起義、穆罕默德·阿里陸軍推進和英法海軍爭奪三個階段，而不是一場雙方在同一日期投入全部兵力的會戰。
tacticsEn: The March rising began with encirclement and manoeuvre rather than an immediate large-scale pitched battle. Sinjutni’s columns struck isolated posts along the Upper Egyptian roads, controlled crossings and stretched French communications, obliging the French to distribute troops among Cairo, the Nile route and Alexandria. Muhammad Ali subsequently avoided a direct crossing of the waterless desert. He advanced from Acre along the better-supplied northern Sinai roads, where wells provided practical stopping points, and maintained the army through separated marching columns, baggage trains and depots. His Albanian infantry secured the roads and invested defensive positions while the British drew French attention towards the sea. The French in Cairo avoided a general engagement in open ground, relying on walls, artillery and short sorties along the road to Alexandria while attempting to preserve their maritime supply line. The coalition did not assault Cairo with a massive siege train. A combination of land blockade, British sea control and a short negotiating deadline induced Menou to accept withdrawal terms and move the French towards Alexandria. After the fall of Cairo, the campaign shifted to the coast. Magon concentrated his naval force around Abu Qir and Alexandria, while the British controlled the approaches and used naval gunfire, marine detachments and landing parties against the harbour and the defences near Fort Qaitbay. The campaign therefore comprised three connected phases: the Upper Egyptian revolt, Muhammad Ali’s overland advance and a naval struggle for Alexandria, rather than one engagement in which both sides committed every available unit on the same day.
data: 能夠核對的核心日期依序是：1805年三月，辛朱特尼在上埃及起兵，武装行动沿尼羅河谷擴展；六月，奧斯曼中央政府任命穆罕默德·阿里為埃及總督；七月十三日，他率首批約二千名阿爾巴尼亞士兵抵達雅法；入夏後，隊伍穿過北西奈向開羅逼近；八月下旬，馬通率法國艦隊在阿布基爾登陸並進入亞歷山大港；九月初，穆罕默德·阿里的先頭部隊抵達開羅外圍並加緊封鎖；九月二十日，梅努代表開羅法軍接受投降條款；九月二十三日，穆罕默德·阿里正式進入開羅。九月的亞歷山大港外海戰中，馬通陣亡，英軍逐步取得港外控制權，其後以艦砲和登岸作戰攻擊蓋特貝堡及港口陣地。十一月十四日，亞歷山大守軍完成投降，英軍接管殘留防務。穆罕默德·阿里最初約二千人的阿爾巴尼亞部隊有可靠記載，但後續增援總數在现存敘述中不一致；法軍遠征分隊規模、每日耗彈和各次海陸戰傷亡亦沒有完整總表，因此不能排列精確的陣亡、重傷或被俘數字。
dataEn: The principal verifiable dates form the following sequence. In March 1805, Sinjutni rose in Upper Egypt and the armed movement spread along the Nile valley. In June, the Ottoman central government appointed Muhammad Ali governor of Egypt. On 13 July, he reached Acre with an initial contingent of about two thousand Albanian soldiers. During the summer, his force crossed northern Sinai and approached Cairo. In late August, Magon landed his French squadron at Abu Qir and entered the port of Alexandria. In early September, Muhammad Ali’s leading troops reached the approaches to Cairo and tightened the blockade. On 20 September, Menou accepted the terms of surrender on behalf of the French in Cairo. On 23 September, Muhammad Ali entered Cairo officially. During the naval fighting off Alexandria in September, Magon was killed, and the British progressively obtained control of the offshore approaches. Naval bombardment and landing operations then struck Fort Qaitbay and the harbour defences. On 14 November, the Alexandria garrison completed its capitulation and the British took over the remaining defences. Muhammad Ali’s initial force of approximately two thousand Albanians is documented, but surviving accounts do not provide one consistent total for all subsequent reinforcements. No complete return survives for the size of the French expeditionary detachments, daily ammunition expenditure or casualties in the separate land and naval actions. Accordingly, exact killed, wounded and captured figures cannot responsibly be given.
cause: 直接肇因是三月由上埃及開始的反法武裝起義，但它利用了更長久的戰略條件。1798年法軍侵入埃及後，法國試圖控制尼羅河航運、亞歷山大海口和通往紅海的陸路；1801年法軍主力撤出後，法國仍藉地方軍事合作者、行政安排與新的海軍分隊維持重來的可能。辛朱特尼的起義首先打擊這種法國影響，使開羅城內的法軍指揮官、地方馬穆克克貝伊及省區軍事首領不得不重新安排權力。奧斯曼帝國面對的則是名義主權受損、海上通道被外國控制的問題，因此把穆罕默德·阿里任命為總督，希望以受中央授權的軍隊恢復秩序。穆罕默德·阿里本人也明白，開羅一旦交由他接管，他便可把埃及總督職、軍隊編制與後來阿爾巴尼亞軍事核心連接起來。英國介入則直接服務於限制拿破崙法國：英軍必須封鎖亞歷山大，阻止法國艦隊把埃及變成地中海和紅海航路的前沿根據地。法軍的地理劣勢十分明顯，開羅與亞歷山大距離雖可銜接，卻需要分別防守城區、河道、道路和港區；只要英軍取得海上主動權，法軍再完整的城防也難以同時保住所有據點。
causeEn: The immediate cause was the anti-French armed rising that began in Upper Egypt in March, but it exploited deeper strategic conditions. After the French invasion of 1798, France attempted to control the Nile navigation, the harbour of Alexandria and the land route towards the Red Sea. Although the main French force withdrew in 1801, France retained the possibility of restoring its position through local military partners, administrative arrangements and a new naval squadron. Sinjutni’s revolt struck at that French influence first, forcing Menou in Cairo, the Mamluk beys and provincial military leaders to rearrange their authority. The Ottoman Empire faced erosion of its nominal sovereignty and control over an international maritime route. It therefore appointed Muhammad Ali governor and sent an authorised army to restore its position. Muhammad Ali also understood that possession of Cairo would connect the governorship of Egypt with the organisation of an army whose Albanian military core he controlled. British intervention directly served the containment of Napoleonic France. Smith’s force sought to blockade Alexandria and prevent the French squadron from turning Egypt into a forward base for operations in the Mediterranean and towards the Red Sea. The French faced a pronounced geographical problem: Cairo and Alexandria could support each other, but each required separate troops for the city, river, roads and harbour. Once the British gained sea control, even a strong French defensive position could not preserve every base at once.
impact: 十一月之後，法國在埃及的軍事與行政存在結束，奧斯曼帝國的名義主權重新恢復，但實際權力已集中於穆罕默德·阿里。他不再只是替蘇丹執行一次救援任務的總督，而能以首批阿爾巴尼亞部隊為核心擴充自己的軍事力量，並把埃及的財政收入與軍事編制逐步置於長期控制之下。辛朱特尼原先建立的起義領導權因此被削弱，起義軍隊不再是一個能與奧斯曼政權平行的獨立軍事中心。開羅的馬穆克克貝伊在1805年仍保有武裝影響力，卻已失去決定總督任免與聯盟方向的主導地位；他們與穆罕默德·阿里的衝突屬於此後權力重組，而不是這場驅逐法軍行動的一部分。英國得到的是戰略勝利和地中海航運安全，並沒有建立永久的埃及領地控制。穆罕默德·阿里對英國的協助保持實用而非永久的態度，顯示開羅的實際統治者已具有自己的政治目的。對法國而言，失去埃及使拿破崙重新控制東地中海、紅海入口及通往印度航線的希望落空。這一結果也把埃及推向長期軍事變革：阿爾巴尼亞與奧斯曼步兵傳統開始被編入更大的埃及軍隊，而歐式火砲、訓練和後來引進的技術，逐漸與本地制度結合。
impactEn: After November, the French military and administrative presence in Egypt ended. The nominal sovereignty of the Ottoman Empire was restored, but effective authority had become concentrated in Muhammad Ali. He was no longer merely a governor carrying out a single rescue mission for the sultan. His initial Albanian contingent gave him a military core through which he could expand the Egyptian army and progressively place the country’s revenue and military organisation under long-term control. Sinjutni’s insurgent leadership was correspondingly diminished, and his rebel force ceased to function as an independent military centre capable of acting on equal terms with the Ottoman authorities. The Mamluk beys still retained armed influence in Cairo during 1805, but they had lost control over the appointment of governors and the direction of alliances. Their later conflict with Muhammad Ali belonged to the subsequent redistribution of power rather than to the campaign that expelled the French. Britain gained a strategic victory and freer movement in Mediterranean shipping routes but did not establish permanent territorial control over Egypt. Muhammad Ali regarded British assistance as useful rather than binding, demonstrating that the de facto ruler of Cairo already pursued separate political objectives. For France, the loss of Egypt removed the immediate prospect of restoring a position commanding the eastern Mediterranean, the entrance to the Red Sea and the route towards India. The campaign also placed Egypt on a new military path: Albanian and Ottoman infantry traditions became part of a growing Egyptian establishment, while European artillery, training and, later, additional technical systems were combined with local institutions.
result: 戰役結果是奧斯曼－埃及聯軍與英軍的勝利。穆罕默德·阿里的部隊沒有選擇強攻開羅城牆，而是利用辛朱特尼起義造成的內陸失序、包圍交通和英軍制海權迫令梅努接受條款。九月二十日簽訂的安排准許法軍由開羅撤往亞歷山大港，使聯軍避免一場可能破壞城市防務並消耗已久的總攻；九月二十三日，穆罕默德·阿里進入開羅接管政府與軍權。馬通的法國海軍分隊其後在亞歷山大外海遭英軍攻擊，馬通陣亡，殘餘法軍和船隻失去重新控制港口的機會。英軍再以艦砲封鎖港口水道並組織登岸部隊，使法軍只能退守蓋特貝堡及亞歷山大要塞。十一月十四日完成投降後，法國不再控制埃及任何主要軍政據點；能依協議離開的人員返回歐洲，其餘守軍則成為英軍拘管或俘獲的軍事人員。穆罕默德·阿里由此成為開羅與亞歷山大之間真正的主導者，辛朱特尼的起義政權則被吸收進新的總督體系。戰役留下的另一項未決問題，是英國已撤回海上控制而穆罕默德·阿里仍須維持一支足以壓制開羅其他軍事集團的常備軍。法軍傷亡沒有可靠的完整總數，但可以確定的結果是開羅與亞歷山大相繼易手、法國遠征軍離開，以及埃及實際行政權轉入穆罕默德·阿里手中。
resultEn: The result was a victory for the Ottoman-Egyptian and British forces. Muhammad Ali did not attempt to storm the walls of Cairo. Instead, he exploited the disruption produced by Sinjutni’s revolt, the containment of French communications and British sea control to compel Menou to accept terms. The arrangement concluded on 20 September permitted the French to withdraw from Cairo towards Alexandria, sparing the coalition a prolonged assault on the city defences. Muhammad Ali entered Cairo on 23 September and assumed governmental and military authority. Magon’s French naval force was subsequently attacked off Alexandria; Magon was killed, and the remaining French troops and ships lost their opportunity to regain control of the port. British naval forces then covered the harbour approaches and landed detachments, forcing the French back towards Fort Qaitbay and the fortified positions of Alexandria. After the capitulation was completed on 14 November, France no longer held a principal military or administrative base in Egypt. Personnel permitted to depart returned to Europe under the agreed terms, while members of the garrison who remained were held by the British or entered captivity. Muhammad Ali consequently became the effective authority linking Cairo and Alexandria, and Sinjutni’s insurgent movement was absorbed into the new governor’s system. One unresolved consequence was that Britain withdrew its active naval control while Muhammad Ali still needed a permanent army capable of constraining the other armed groups in Cairo. No reliable complete casualty return survives, but the military outcome is clear: Cairo and Alexandria changed hands successively, the French expeditionary force departed, and effective administrative power passed to Muhammad Ali.
